name: Agent trigger
description: An automation rule on an agent: a named, enableable source that decides when it fires, the prompt a fired thread starts from, and an optional continuation that wakes a parked run or calls a tool or script headlessly instead of starting a thread.

prompt.description: First message of the thread a firing starts. Required for a newThread continuation; optional for tool and script continuations, where it is used only when onFailure escalates to a thread.
